cases.source: The backup process shall verify the checksum. It shall abort on any mismatch.
cases.correct: The backup process shall abort on any mismatch.
cases.wrong: The checksum shall abort on any mismatch.

cases.source: The parser and verifier shall record their versions. They shall reject incompatible schemas.
cases.correct: The parser and verifier shall reject incompatible schemas.
cases.wrong: Their versions shall reject incompatible schemas.

cases.source: The producer writes candidate.json and the verifier writes verdict.json. The former must not overwrite the latter.
cases.correct: The producer must not overwrite verdict.json.
cases.wrong: The verifier must not overwrite candidate.json.

cases.source: The primary node must persist the lease. The replica must, too.
cases.correct: The replica must persist the lease.
cases.wrong: The replica must delete the lease.

cases.source: If maintenance mode is enabled, the service shall reject writes. In that mode, it may still serve reads.
cases.correct: When maintenance mode is enabled, the service may still serve reads.
cases.wrong: When maintenance mode is enabled, maintenance mode may still serve reads.

cases.source: The verifier shall recompute the manifest hash. This validation must occur before promotion.
cases.correct: Recomputing the manifest hash must occur before promotion.
cases.wrong: Promotion must occur before recomputing the manifest hash.

cases.source: The producer and verifier shall write candidate.json and verdict.json, respectively.
cases.correct: The producer shall write candidate.json and the verifier shall write verdict.json.
cases.wrong: The producer shall write verdict.json and the verifier shall write candidate.json.

ambiguity_diagnostic.source: The loader notified the verifier after the parser failed because it was unavailable.
